description: R08 DeserializationTests profile-property seam: safe Rust composes the migrated profile collection with closeOnExit compatibility, profiles.defaults precedence, prohibited GUID inheritance, dynamic-profile defaults and explicit profile lookup.

entries.notes: String closeOnExit modes map to Graceful/Always/Never/Automatic and null/unknown values resolve to Automatic.
Legacy boolean closeOnExit values remain compatible: true maps to Graceful and false maps to Never.
profiles.defaults historySize applies before each explicit user profile, so local profile values override the default while omitted values inherit it.
GUID is an identity field and is never inherited from profiles.defaults; explicit GUIDs remain local and GUID-less profiles stay identity-generated.
Dynamic/inbox profile values form the base, user profiles.defaults layer above them, and explicit user profile values win last while preserving user-first ordering.
Explicit profile GUID lookup returns the matching profile and returns None for a GUID absent from the effective collection.
